verdict.score_rationale: The board lands on the comfortably readable anchor because its spacious, strongly tinted sections make the overall structure clear, though small text and several tightly routed or overlapping publication-to-retrieval edges slow arm's-length reading.

sub_checks.name: corridors_and_air
sub_checks.note: Most nodes and label chips have ample surrounding space, but the small chips and closely stacked lines around the publication and retrieval boundary create a few tight reading spots.

sub_checks.name: grouping
sub_checks.note: Distinct pastel regions with titled headers clearly separate the five main stages, three supporting areas, and reading guide without requiring edge tracing.

sub_checks.name: edge_legibility
sub_checks.note: The left-to-right main flow is traceable, but multiple long parallel and bending runs converge around embedding, publication, and hybrid retrieval, including a visually ambiguous overlap near the keyword/vector inputs.

sub_checks.name: density_and_decomposition
sub_checks.note: Air is the clear majority of the board and sections generally contain only two or three nodes, although the overall canvas scale makes many node labels relatively small at arm's length.
